behavior: Finite raw.read captures bounded caller JSON, admits only five known read commands (finite subscribe requires live:false), refuses top-level mutation IDs, then uses the existing Rust raw_request parser/intent classifier and signed peer. Full frozen schema, current authority, signature/correlation and original helper ownership remain in Rust. App polling no longer launches a synchronous validator subprocess. No caching, automatic reconnect, retry or request/media deadline changes.

local_blocking_mechanism.scope: Local frozen schema validation only; no network, credentials, SDK helper or media. This measures a blocking mechanism, not its share of CI timeout.

production_runtime_read_probe.scope: Actual production Mac runtime with current source Node adapter. Read-only local synthetic fixture; no media, replay, model or provider. Not an installed-package or app CI qualification.

synthetic_helper_suite.scope: Synthetic owned raw/typed helper and bounded authenticated media/data lifecycle, typed local operation reconstruction, negative declaration checks and fake local HTTP only. Fixture-shaped signatures are not cryptographic, real-server, installed parity or full G6-062 qualification.
